svg.desc: Claude Code skills, hooks and an agent for measurement-driven chemistry development. Seven spectral lines on a nanometre scale stand for the loop: measure, cluster, target, spy, fix, gate, review.
svg.text: Decide from measurement, not from a confident guess.
